module: Execution engine of the crawl mode (slow traversal of a trail with waypoints). It keeps the state of each crawler (crawlStates, keyed by vehicle id): current node, nodes cleared or skipped, timer, penalty points, events, recovery point, disqualification. Every frame, updateCrawl advances the timer, reads the vehicle position, detects reached nodes (2D test on the bounding box center, with a direction check if the node has a rotation), checks the boundary zone (gameplay_crawl_boundary), infractions (driving backwards, touching dynamic gates) and the DNF threshold. It also manages the 3D gate markers (shared or per player in split screen), the dotted preview line, the loading of the trail's prefabs, the integration with core_lapTimes and vehicle resets. The scoring table is in infractionPoints.
usage: gameplay_crawl_utils.setDebugDraw(true)  -- shows path, zone and start of the active trail
notes: Default scale (points, lower = better): drivingBackwards 1, vehicleFlippedUpright 5, gateTouch 10, vehicleReset 10, boundaryViolation 10, wrongDirection 10, skippedCheckpoint 10, dnf 50, gateCleared -2, bonusGateCleared -15. The total never goes below 0.
DNF: reached when points >= trail.rules.dnfPointLimit (if > 0), otherwise 50. trail.rules.penalties == false disables all penalties (hasPenalties).
Cooldowns (s): drivingBackwards 5, boundaryViolation 3. Driving backwards: dot product of velocity/direction (2D) < -0.5; penalty after cumulative distance > 2.

Clearing a node: the bounding box center (bbCenter) must be within the radius (4.0 m by default) in XY; if the node has a rotation, the vehicle must face and (above 1 m/s) drive in the direction (dot product > 0.5). Only nodes current-1 to current+1 are tested; skipping a node (non-bonus) costs skippedCheckpoint per skipped node. Without penalties, one can only advance in order (except bonus).
A finished crawl (last node) triggers onCrawlResultsShown, unlocks the CHALLENGE_CRAWL achievement, and the crawler is removed 3 s later (completionDelay) unless it comes from a mission.

Vehicle reset: with trail.rules.recovery.mode == 'lastGate', the reset key sends back to the last cleared node (or to the start) with the vehicleReset penalty (recoverToLastGate); otherwise, a detected teleport (> 1 m) outside a mission causes an immediate DNF, and in a mission a vehicleFlippedUpright penalty.
The extension replaces commands.dropPlayerAtCameraNoReset to count a reset; the original function is restored in onExtensionUnloaded.
Marker modes: inactive, final, skipped, current, bonus, recovery, finished (aggregation priority for a shared camera: finished > bonus = recovery > current > skipped > final > inactive).

Probable bug: calculatePathStats ignores pathReversed (the loop reassigns the local index i with no effect) and the cache is keyed by pathId alone; elevation gain and loss are therefore not swapped for a reversed trail.
Inconsistency: if core_lapTimes is not yet loaded when this file is read, the local variable core_lapTimes stays nil for the whole session.
drawMarkers reads the global photoModeOpen, presumably defined elsewhere.

Emitted hooks: onCrawlPenaltyScoreChanged({crawlerId, penaltyScore, oldPenaltyScore}), onCrawlPathnodeReached({crawlerId, pathnodeId, pathnodeIndex, time, pathnodeTimings}), onCrawlResultsShown({crawlerId, time, points}), onCrawlDisqualified({crawlerId}), showDisqualifiedMessage({crawlerId, time}), onCrawlCleared().

infractionPoints.desc: Points per infraction type (see notes). Negative values = bonus.

infractionCooldowns.desc: Repeat delays in seconds: drivingBackwards = 5, boundaryViolation = 3.

drivingBackwardsSettings.desc: Backward driving detection settings: velocityDotThreshold = -0.5, distanceThreshold = 2.

startCrawl.desc: Creates the crawler state (node 1, timer 0, points kept in crawlerData), prepares the gate markers of the active path, shows the start and points messages, and configures core_lapTimes (a single lap, one segment per node). Requires gameplay_crawl_general.activeTrail with a non-empty path.

isFromMission.desc: True if started by a mission: the crawler is then not automatically removed at the end.

returns.desc: false if invalid parameters or empty path.

stopCrawl.desc: Stops time tracking (core_lapTimes.onRaceStop), clears the zone exit points and calls clear. Without force, does nothing if an active crawl comes from a mission.

force.desc: True to stop even a mission crawl.

resetCrawlData.desc: Resets the crawler state (node 1, timer, points, infractions, events; crawlStarted becomes false), clears the messages and time tracking.

force.desc: Required to reset a mission crawl.

returns.desc: false if the crawler is unknown, inactive, or protected (mission without force).

resumeCrawlTimer.desc: Starts the timer of a crawler that is prepared but not yet started (crawlStarted becomes true) and shows the start and points messages.

returns.desc: true if the timer is running (already started or started now).

updateCrawl.desc: Per-frame update of all active crawlers: boundary zone animations, timer, position, reached nodes, zone, infractions, events, time flow to core_lapTimes, points messages, DNF and removal of finished crawlers.

setupCrawlerData.desc: Creates the dynamic data of a crawler for a vehicle: id, points, bounding box (getSpawnWorldOOBB), wheel offsets (reference corners), infraction values; also registers the accZSmooth notification.

returns.desc: Crawler data, nil if veh is nil.

applyPenalty.desc: Adds points to the crawler (negative = bonus; total clamped to 0), emits onCrawlPenaltyScoreChanged and logs the event. No effect if the crawler is inactive or if penalties are disabled.

points.desc: Points to add; otherwise the value of infractionPoints[penaltyType].

hasPenalties.desc: Indicates whether the crawler's trail applies penalties (true unless trail.rules.penalties == false).

onBoundaryViolation.desc: Applies the boundaryViolation penalty and shows the message, except during the 3 s delay. Called by gameplay_crawl_boundary.checkBoundary.

onVehicleFlippedUpright.desc: Applies the vehicleFlippedUpright penalty and shows the message.

onVehicleReset.desc: Counts a vehicle recovery. With isGateRecovery: vehicleReset penalty and a 5 s delay without backward driving penalty; otherwise, in a mission: vehicleFlippedUpright penalty; outside a mission: dnf penalty (trail threshold), hence disqualification.

isGateRecovery.desc: True if the recovery comes from recoverToLastGate.

recoverToLastGate.desc: Teleports the vehicle to the last cleared node (or the starting position), with the node's rotation or a direction inferred from the neighboring node, repairs the vehicle unless recovery.repairVehicle == false, and applies the recovery penalty. Requires trail.rules.recovery.mode == 'lastGate'.

returns.desc: true if the teleportation took place.

trackVehReset.desc: Called when the player resets their vehicle: with the last-node recovery rule, cancels the recovery preview then requests recoverToLastGate; otherwise, stores the position to detect a real teleport (> 1 m) on the next frame and apply onVehicleReset.

vehId.desc: Vehicle id; if nil, the crawler of the player who last used a device, or all active crawlers.

getCrawlState.desc: Returns the full state of a crawler: active, trail, crawlerData, currentPathnodeIndex, completedPathnodes, skippedPathnodes, pathnodeTimings, eventLog, currentTime, isCompleted, completionStartTime, events, crawlStarted, lastRecoveryCheckpoint, lastRecoveryCheckpointIndex, lastReachedPathnodeIndex, isDisqualified, recoveryCount, isFromMission, raceData.

returns.desc: false if a parameter is missing.

getAllCrawlStates.desc: Returns the internal table of all states (keyed by vehicle id), without copying.

getActiveCrawlerId.desc: Returns the id of the first active crawler found.

getCrawlerPosition.desc: Returns the last known position of a crawler (reference to a continuously updated vec3).

getCrawlerDirection.desc: Returns the vehicle orientation reduced to its yaw (rotation around Z).

getLastRecoveryCheckpoint.desc: Returns the last recovery point cleared by an active crawler.

getLastRecoveryCheckpointIndex.desc: Returns the index of the last recovery point of an active crawler.

returns.desc: Index; 0 if none or crawler inactive.

setRecoveryCheckpoint.desc: Forces the recovery point of an active crawler and enables the 5 s delay without backward driving penalty.

returns.desc: false if parameters are missing or the crawler is inactive.

clear.desc: Clears the markers, unloads the prefabs, removes all crawler states, resets gameplay_crawl_general.activeTrail to nil, emits onCrawlCleared and clears the messages. Without force, does nothing if a mission crawl is active.

force.desc: True to clear everything even in a mission.

clearCrawler.desc: Removes a crawler (its per-player markers and its state).

clearMarkers.desc: Removes all gate markers and leaves preview mode.

setupCrawlMarkers.desc: Creates the gate markers of a path (all hidden, the last one as 'final'), builds the dotted line from the player's position and switches to preview mode. No effect if the markers of this path already exist.

activateCrawlMarkers.desc: Activates the first marker ('current') of the active path and leaves preview mode.

drawMarkers.desc: Updates and displays the gate markers (hidden in photo mode). Called by onPreRender.

loadPrefabs.desc: Spawns the trail's prefabs (canSave = false, added to MissionGroup), prevents automatic entry into vehicles, finds the objects carrying the dynamic field 'crawlDynamic' (gates that cost gateTouch if touched), reloads collisions then creates the boundary zone flags (5 m spacing).

unloadPrefabs.desc: Removes the created prefabs, reloads collisions, empties the dynamic objects and the zone markers.

getDynamicObjectsFromPrefab.desc: Lists the ids of the children of a prefab whose dynamic field has the value dynamicName.

returns.desc: Ids of the objects found; empty if absent.

calculatePathStats.desc: Computes total distance and elevation change of a path (in 5 m steps) and caches the result.

returns.desc: {totalDistance (m), totalElevationChange (m), elevationGain, elevationLoss}; nil if the path has fewer than 2 positions.

setDebugDraw.desc: Enables or disables the debug overlay (path, boundary zone, starting position).

isDebugDrawEnabled.desc: Indicates whether the debug overlay is active.

isPreviewMode.desc: Indicates whether the markers are in preview mode (before the crawl starts).

getDottedPath.desc: Returns the points of the dotted preview line.

onPreRender.desc: Hook called before rendering: displays the markers, the dotted preview (in preview mode), the paused guidance and the debug overlay.

onDrawOnMinimap.desc: Minimap drawing hook: draws the gate markers (those of player 0 in split screen).

onSplitScreenChanged.desc: Hook called when split screen changes: rebuilds the markers (per player in 'split' mode, otherwise shared).

onSpawnCCallback.desc: Hook called when an object is created: during prefab loading, disables automatic entry into the created vehicle.

onExtensionUnloaded.desc: Hook called on unload: restores commands.dropPlayerAtCameraNoReset.
